undecryptable.staleEpoch: This message was encrypted for an earlier member list and can't be read.
undecryptable.invalid: This message failed verification and isn't shown.
undecryptable.unencrypted: This message isn't encrypted, so it isn't shown.

revision.stale: The server returned an older version. Showing the latest version
revision.conflict: A different message arrived with the same version. Showing the one received first

undeliverable.title: These people can't read new messages

desktopUnsupported.title: Encrypted channel
desktopUnsupported.description: This client can't show encrypted channels. Open it in the web or mobile app.

e2ee.sendUnavailable: Sending to encrypted channels isn't available in this version yet.
e2ee.deviceNotReady: Encryption isn't ready on this device or tab yet. Check that it's set up and unlocked, and close other zoo tabs.
e2ee.sendNeedsUnlock: Unlock encryption on this device to send to encrypted channels.
e2ee.sendStaleEpoch: The member list kept changing, so the message wasn't sent. Try again.
e2ee.editConflict: This message was edited elsewhere. Reload it and edit again.
e2ee.downgraded: This channel was encrypted, but the server now says it isn't. Messages won't be sent unencrypted.

devices.title: Devices
devices.name: Device name
devices.deleteIsNotRevocation: Deleting a device does not revoke it. A deleted device can still read the current backup with the keys it holds. Delete lost or unfamiliar devices from “Start revocation”.
devices.deleteConfirmDescription: Deleting is not revocation. If the device is lost or unfamiliar, cancel and delete it from “Start revocation”.
devices.limitTitle: You have reached the device limit (20)
devices.limitDescription: This device cannot be registered. Choose devices you no longer use and delete them. Deleting is not revocation, so if a device was lost, also revoke it after this device is registered.
devices.limitStale: Not used for 30 days or more
devices.limitDeleted: Deleted. This device will register again shortly.

revocation.pendingDescription: A revocation you started earlier is not finished. Unlock Secret Storage again and save the rest.
revocation.needsUnlock: Revocation and re-verification are available on a device that has unlocked encryption.
revocation.title: Revoke devices and keys
revocation.description: Delete lost or unfamiliar devices and replace your keys. Your other devices will not receive keys until they unlock again.
revocation.selectDescription: Select lost and unfamiliar devices. Do not rely on device names; check when each device was added and last used.

scope.full: A passkey, the recovery key, or the Secret Storage key

scopeDescription.device_only: Replaces the self-signing, user-signing, and backup keys. Keeps your master key and recovery key.
scopeDescription.full: Also replaces your master key, Secret Storage key, and recovery key. Other people will need to verify you again. Choose this if unsure.

revocation.irreversible: Revocation cannot undo past messages that were already downloaded, the contents of old backups, or keys held by deleted devices.
revocation.unlockDescription: Before you start, unlock Secret Storage again with a passkey or your recovery key.
revocation.unlockResume: To continue the unfinished revocation, unlock Secret Storage again with a passkey or your recovery key. If a full revocation already created a new recovery key, use the new one.
revocation.newRecoveryKey: This is your new recovery key. Save it before you continue. After the revocation, your old recovery key and passkeys will no longer unlock.
revocation.passkeyDescription: Let this device's passkey unlock (add other passkeys later from the Encryption tab).
revocation.fullWarning: Other members of your channels will not send keys to your new devices until they verify you again.
revocation.notesTitle: People who will not be re-signed
revocation.notesDescription: This device has no confirmed record of these people. After the revocation, they receive no keys until you verify them again.

note.pin_replaced: the server's record differed and will be replaced with this device's record
note.signature_unverified: the signature could not be verified
note.master_key_mismatch: the signed key differs from the record
note.stale_confirmation: Confirmed with an older user-signing key (needs re-verification)

revocation.versionsWithoutKey: Some backups cannot be moved to the new version (versions {{versions}}). Neither this device nor Secret Storage has their keys, so their messages cannot be restored.
revocation.executeDescription: You will sign in again to confirm it is you, then new keys are created and saved.

stage.signatures_saved: Creating a new key backup version…
stage.backup_created: Moving old backups to the new version…

revocation.conflict: This revocation got mixed up with one on another device. Unlock Secret Storage again and start over (keys for backups that were not deleted are carried over).
revocation.unsignedTitle: Devices not signed with the new keys
revocation.unsignedDescription: These devices receive no keys until they unlock again with a passkey or the recovery key. Delete any you do not recognize.
revocation.droppedSessions_one: {{count}} session from the old backup could not be moved.
revocation.droppedSessions_other: {{count}} sessions from the old backup could not be moved.

verification.title: Verifying other people
verification.description: Key status of the people you share encrypted channels with. If someone's key changes, they receive no keys until you verify them again.
verification.empty: You do not share an encrypted channel with anyone.

trusted.shared_pin: Trusting the first key seen (recorded by your other device)

reason.master_key_changed: Their key changed. They receive no keys until you verify them again.
reason.not_confirmed: Their key is not confirmed. They receive no keys until you verify them again.
reason.user_signing_key_changed: Your signing key changed, so you need to confirm them again.

state.blocked: Not sending keys because your own keys could not be checked

verification.confirmDescription: Compare the fingerprint below with the one on {{name}}'s screen (Encryption settings, “Your key fingerprint”) outside the channel (in person or another way), and trust it only if they match. You will sign in again to confirm it is you before saving.
verification.keyChanged: This key differs from the one you trusted before. Make sure they really replaced their keys.
verification.keyUnchanged: This is the same key you trusted before.
verification.sasRecommended: If you can, use “Verify” instead to check with a QR code or emoji. It checks that you both see the same key without reading out the fingerprint.
verification.confirmEffect: Trusting signs this key with your user-signing key, and all your devices will trust it.
verification.ownFingerprintHelp: Others compare this fingerprint when they verify you again.

warning.own_identity_unknown: Your master key has not been checked yet. Unlock to check it.
warning.own_master_key_changed: The master key on the server differs from the one this device checked. No keys are sent to any device until you unlock again.
warning.untrusted_user_signing_key: Your user-signing key could not be checked. No keys are sent to other people.
warning.user_signing_key_rollback: Your user-signing key was rolled back to an old key that had been replaced. The server may have been tampered with, so no keys are sent to other people.
warning.user_signing_key_changed: Your user-signing key changed. People who were not re-signed need to be verified again.

authz.revokeSessions: In “Security”, sign out all sessions except this one (within 5 minutes of signing in again).
authz.disconnect: In “Connected services”, disconnect every zoo connection (Web, Android, TUI).
authz.disconnectAgain: In “Connected services”, disconnect every zoo connection again (signing in during the revocation issues new tokens).
authz.signOut: Finally, sign out on this device too, and sign in again.
authz.note: Deleting devices does not end sign-in sessions or tokens. Issued tokens work until they expire, so if you strongly suspect a takeover, also ask an administrator to suspend the account.
authz.acknowledge: I ended the sessions and disconnected the services in AuthZ

recovery.newDescription: After saving, the old recovery key no longer unlocks. Deleting or replacing a key slot is not revocation; if the old recovery key may have leaked, also revoke from the Devices section on this tab.
recovery.removeDescription: This recovery key will no longer unlock. Keys already obtained stay valid. If it may have leaked, revoke.

e2ee.resetDevicesDescription: Select unfamiliar devices to delete them. If someone else set up encryption for your account, you must finish this choice before the reset completes so the attacker's devices are not left behind.
e2ee.resetDevicesConfirm: I selected unfamiliar devices (or confirmed there are none)

attachments.decryptFailed: Couldn't decrypt the attachment. Its contents may have been altered.
attachments.blocked: This file type is blocked for safety

legacy.unencryptedBadgeHelp: This unencrypted message appears after encrypted messages. A trustworthy server cannot create such a message in an encrypted channel, so the server may have added or changed it.
legacy.editCancelled: This channel is now encrypted, so editing a message sent before encryption was cancelled.
legacy.editForbidden: Messages sent before encryption can't be edited. You can still delete them.

convert.settingHelp: Encrypt messages from now on. This can't be turned off later.
convert.title: Encrypt this channel?

points.future: New messages and attachments can be read only by members' verified devices.
points.earlier: Earlier messages stay unencrypted on the server and can no longer be edited (you can still delete them).
points.published: Posts already shared to Home or ActivityPub are not withdrawn.
points.integrations: Slack imports and sync stop. Remove apps (bots) and incoming webhooks first.
points.irreversible: Encryption can't be turned off later.

blockers.apps: An app (bot) is a member. Remove it from the channel first.
blockers.webhooks: The channel has incoming webhooks. Delete them first.
blockers.encrypted_dm: You already have an encrypted DM with this person.

sas.incomingDescription: You'll confirm each other's keys by scanning a QR code or by checking that the same emoji appear on both screens. Accept only when you can compare screens outside this channel, such as in person or on a call.
sas.requestedDescription: We sent a verification request to their devices. The emoji appear once they accept.
sas.compareDescription: Check that the same emoji appear in the same order on their screen. When you choose “They match”, you'll sign in again to confirm it's you, and then their key is saved as verified.
sas.savedDescription: {{name}}'s key is saved as verified. If this key changes, we'll stop sharing keys with them until you verify again.
sas.reauth: We couldn't confirm it's you, so the verification wasn't saved. Sign in again to save it.

cancelled.timeout: The verification didn't finish within 10 minutes, so it was stopped.
cancelled.mismatchedSas: The emoji didn't match, so the verification was stopped. Their key may have been replaced.
cancelled.keyMismatch: The keys didn't match, so the verification was stopped. A key may have been replaced.
cancelled.accepted: The verification continued on another of your devices.
cancelled.unknownMethod: Their device doesn't support this method, so the verification was stopped.

sas.needsUnlock: This device isn't unlocked, so it can't verify. Unlock it under Settings → Encryption.
sas.sendFailed: We couldn't reach them. Check your connection and try again.
sas.receiveFailed: We couldn't process their reply. We'll try again automatically; check your connection.

qr.title: Verify {{name}}
qr.showHint: Ask {{name}} to scan this QR code with their device. If a camera isn't available or you're apart, verify with emoji instead.
qr.waitingForAccept: Once {{name}} accepts the request, they can scan this QR code with their device.
qr.scanHint: Point the camera at the QR code on the other person's screen.
qr.otherCode: This QR code isn't for this verification. Point the camera at the QR code currently on the other person's screen.
qr.waitingForConfirm: Waiting for the other person to confirm the scan on their screen…
qr.confirmDescription: Choose “Scanned” only if {{name}} scanned this QR code with their device in front of you. You'll sign in again to confirm it's you, then their key will be saved as verified.
qr.verifiedTitle: Confirmed {{name}}'s key with the QR code
qr.needsLogin: Sign in again to confirm it's you and save the key as verified.
qr.keyMismatch: The key in the QR code didn't match the key from the server, so the verification was stopped. A key may have been replaced.

camera.label: Camera view
camera.unsupported: The camera can't be used in this browser. Ask the other person to scan this device's QR code, or verify with emoji.
camera.denied: Camera access wasn't allowed. Allow it in your browser settings, or verify with emoji.
camera.noCamera: No camera was found. Ask the other person to scan this device's QR code, or verify with emoji.
camera.failed: The camera couldn't be started. Verify with emoji instead.

android.saveDescription: Before saving, you will sign in again. A browser opens, and you return to this screen when you finish signing in.
android.continueDescription: Sign in again to save the rest of the interrupted setup. A browser will open.
android.reauthWaiting: Waiting for you to sign in again in the browser…
android.browserUnavailable: Could not open a browser to sign in. Install or enable a browser and press again.

defaultChannels.refreshed: Some channels are no longer available. The list has been refreshed. Review your selection and save again.
defaultChannels.limit: You can select up to 100 public channels.
defaultChannels.title: Default channels for new accounts
defaultChannels.description: Select public channels to join automatically when an account is created. Existing accounts are unaffected.

androidAttachmentCache.title: Image cache
androidAttachmentCache.description: Stores images for this account on this device. Lowering the limit removes the least recently used images first. Turning it off clears saved images.

androidNavigationCache.title: Navigation cache
androidNavigationCache.description: Sets the number of entries kept in memory for Home, post details and profiles, and separately for channels.

androidNotifications.scope: Receive new notifications while your signed-in session is syncing.

welcome.title: Welcome to Zoo
welcome.description: Explore Zoo using the real screens. Next opens the channel list. You can skip and restart with the compass button.

channels.title: Find a channel
channels.description: Choose a channel in the highlighted list. Use Browse channels to find and join more conversations.

messages.title: Join the conversation
messages.description: You can post in the highlighted message box in the channel you opened. Use threads for replies and reactions for quick responses.

notifications.title: Keep up with notifications
notifications.description: This is Notifications. Check mentions and replies here, then select a notification to open its conversation.

settings.title: Make Zoo your own
settings.description: This is General settings. Use the highlighted tabs to adjust display and behavior. You can restart the tour with the compass button.

slack.title: Connect Slack
slack.description: This is Slack settings. Link your Slack account to associate imported past posts with your Zoo account. You can also import private channels you created. Ask an administrator if integration is not configured.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.chooseChannel: Choose a channel to continue. If needed, use Browse channels to join one.
onboarding.navigationError: Could not open the screen. Please try again.

sip.title: Phone (SIP)
sip.description: Manage personal and circle-shared lines and phones. Connect one selected line to make and receive calls. Incoming calls require this browser to remain open and connected.
sip.loadError: Could not load lines. Refresh to try again.
sip.disabled: Phone service is not enabled yet. An administrator must configure the infrastructure.
sip.channelBusy: SIP is unavailable during a channel call.
sip.name: Line name
sip.keepPassword: Leave blank to keep the current password
sip.membersHelp: Only selected members may connect. Select yourself too if needed. Members share SIP credentials; rotate the password on the PBX when removing a member.
sip.phonesHelp: Register a name and extension, then configure the displayed SIP account on the phone.
sip.pbxHelp: Register the PBX domain and account provided by your administrator. The server handles SIP connections. Restrict outbound trunks and numbers on the PBX too.
sip.writeError: Could not save. Check the values and permissions and try again.
sip.deleteHelp: Removes the line and contacts from zoo2. Disable the extension and credentials on the PBX separately.
sip.callError: Connection or operation failed. Check line permissions, PBX and media relay configuration.

androidPhone.description: Use personal or shared SIP lines and DM voice calls with your device’s calling features.
androidPhone.nativeHelp: A call notification appears when a call comes in. Allow notifications to receive DM calls in the background on supported devices. Keep Zoo open in the foreground while waiting for SIP calls or for DM calls on devices without FCM. Device call controls support answering, ending calls and routing audio. Microphone permission is required.
androidPhone.callError: Could not prepare or control the call. Check microphone permission, device calling support, network and line configuration.
androidPhone.speaker: Speaker

globalSearch.title: Search
globalSearch.prompt: Type the words to search for. Separate words with spaces to find results containing all of them.
globalSearch.emptyOlder: No results through {{month}}. You can search further back.
globalSearch.tooManyTerms: You can search for up to {{max}} words. Remove some words and try again.
globalSearch.termTooLong: Each word can be up to {{max}} characters. Shorten the word and try again.
globalSearch.encryptedNote: Encrypted channels are not included in search.

filters.label: Filters
filters.reversed: The start date must be on or before the end date.

catchUp.title: Catch up
catchUp.readError: Could not mark this conversation as read. Please try again.
catchUp.emptyDescription: Check back when new messages arrive
catchUp.unreadTooOld: Some older unread messages are still outside the loaded range. Load more before marking as read.
catchUp.unreadChanged: New unread messages arrived while reading. Keep this conversation unread and continue.
